## Progress

- Needs MDV-P0-006

## Description

Federated credentials (one app identity per environment) so GitHub Actions deploys without stored cloud secrets. deploy-staging.yml runs on a signed tag `v0.*`: build once, run EF Core migration bundle with the migration identity, deploy to the staging slot, smoke test, swap. Production workflow exists but requires a manual approval and only accepts tags from main.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** No Azure client secret or publish profile exists in GitHub secrets (only federated credentials).
- [ ] **AC2.** Pushing tag v0.0.1 on main deploys to staging end-to-end and the health endpoint returns 200 with the tag version.
- [ ] **AC3.** A tag on a non-main commit is rejected by the workflow.
- [ ] **AC4.** Migrations run with the dedicated migration database user, not the app identity.
- [ ] **AC5.** Deploy is repeatable: re-running the same tag is idempotent.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
